name: source-control
description: A Source Control pane like VS Code's: changed files with inline diffs, stage and discard, a commit box with a Haiku-written message, commit, push, pull, sync, branches and stash.

commitModel.title: Commit message model
commitModel.description: The model alias or id the generate button uses. haiku follows the latest Haiku.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every
refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between status checks while the pane is open (changes Claude makes also refresh it at once)

autoOpen.title: Open the pane
autoOpen.description: never: only with /scm; first-change: also once, when this chat first changes a file in a git repository
